action_confirmation.gap: requires an action element (approve/reject buttons emitting effects, not data edits) — Layer 3 territory; dvr/1.0 renders data, it does not act

connection_manager.gap: requires live status indicators and controls (connect, retry) bound to service state, not to dataset bindings

note: gaps are Layer-3 action elements and live service controls; both are out of dvr/1.0 scope by design (spec §8 non-goals)
